_about: Six windows of REAL Doppler rows for app/tests/test_care_fall.py, cut on 2026-11-15 from recorded MacBook sessions (three people, nobody fell). Each row is what the engine sends in a spectrogram event (the mean of the two tone channels, 64 bins, 50 rows a second), stored as whole numbers 0..255 (value x 255), row after row, zlib-compressed and base64-encoded in rows_b64. Made by replaying the session audio through sonar.pipeline.Pipeline; no audio is stored here.

windows.name: stepping_away
windows.what: the person steps away from the laptop (about 8-11 s) and stands still out of the way

windows.name: push_and_back
windows.what: one push toward the laptop and the hand coming back

windows.name: gestures_run
windows.what: five prompted gestures in a row: big swipes and a push

windows.name: one_way_then_shifting
windows.what: a one-way movement, then the person keeps shifting slowly for 14 s

windows.name: walk_in_and_sit
windows.what: walks up to the laptop, sits down, then sits still
